```{r}
library(styler)
```

## Human

```{r}
total_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_human)
```
There are 430 genes with regionally elevated expression in humans compared to the rest of the brain.

## Pig

```{r}
total_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_pig)
```
There are 342 genes with regionally elevated expression in pigs compared to the rest of the brain.

## Mouse

```{r}
total_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_mouse)
```
There are 398 genes with regionally elevated expression in mice compared to the rest of the brain.

Thus, the highest number of genes with elevated expression was 430, in humans.
